subject: Rename redis.tcl to valkey.tcl (#283)
reason: The change is confined to Valkey's own TCL test harness and docs: it renames tests/support/redis.tcl to tests/support/valkey.tcl, updates the source statements in test helper scripts (test_helper.tcl, instances.tcl, bg_block_op.tcl, bg_complex_data.tcl, gen_write_load.tcl, utils/speed-regression.tcl), and rewords a README table and help strings. No file under src/ or any shipped binary (valkey-server, valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark, valkey-check-rdb, valkey-check-aof) is modified, so no command reply, replication, persistence, or cluster behaviour can differ between the parent and the change.
